2608.14446.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports
2608.14446.paper_summary: In the current artificial intelligence-driven innovation era, the pace of knowledge growth is accelerating, and is hard to keep up with. While generative models are increasingly used to synthesize content, they often lack in information grounding. To address these peculiarities of our time, we propose Wyvern, a multi-agent framework for the automated generation of grounded, multimodal technical reports. Wyvern allows for the generation of multimodal outputs, integrating images, tables, and text with supporting references in a unified report. Additionally, a particular focus is placed on the grounding of the content, with the implementation of a claims auto-revision stage. We conduct a human evaluation study to assess the quality of our proposed framework. The results show that the figures' informativeness is perceived as superior to that of a recent baseline in 87% of cases. Furthermore, Wyvern's reports are rated as more useful than those produced by three alternative methods in 63% to 100% of instances. We also carry out automatic evaluations showing that Wyvern gains up to 2.3$\times$ in citation recall and 1.6$\times$ in citation precision with respect to the baselines.
2608.14446.paper_summary_zh: 在當前由人工智慧驅動的創新時代，知識增長的速度正在加快，且難以跟上。雖然生成模型越來越多地用於合成內容，但它們往往缺乏信息的基礎。為了解決我們這個時代的特殊性，我們提出了Wyvern，一個自動生成有根據的多模態技術報告的多代理框架。Wyvern允許生成多模態輸出，將圖像、表格和文本與支持參考整合在一個統一的報告中。此外，特別關注內容的基礎，並實施了主張自動修訂階段。我們進行了一項人類評估研究，以評估我們提出的框架的質量。結果顯示，在87%的案例中，圖表的信息性被認為優於最近的基準。此外，Wyvern的報告在63%到100%的情況下被評為比三種替代方法產生的報告更有用。我們還進行了自動評估，顯示Wyvern在引用召回率上比基準提高了最多2.3$\times$，在引用精確度上提高了1.6$\times$。
